name: Vitamin B12 Deficiency (incl. subacute combined degeneration)

matching.reasoningTemplate: Subacute anaemia with neurological signs - sensory ataxia, dorsal-column/pyramidal deficits and cognitive/behavioural change - points to B12 (cobalamin) deficiency with subacute combined degeneration; often autoimmune (pernicious anaemia).

redFlags: Neurological damage may be irreversible if untreated - do not delay B12 replacement for a haematological response
Do NOT give folate alone (can precipitate/worsen neurological deterioration)
Check for pernicious anaemia (intrinsic-factor antibodies) and other autoimmune disease
